entries.name: Claude Fable 5
entries.summary: Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's most intelligent, generally available "Mythos-class" model released in June 2026. It is designed for long-horizon autonomy, complex reasoning, and professional knowledge work. It has a massive 1 million token context window and up to 128k output tokens per request. Fable 5 excels at agentic workflows, self-verification, and sustained multi-day execution. Notably, it comes with built-in proactive safeguards; if asked a sensitive prompt (e.g., cybersecurity or bio-chem), it automatically falls back to Claude Opus 4.8. (Access to Fable 5 was briefly disrupted days after launch due to US government export-control directives).
entries.architecture: Proprietary Transformer / Large Language Model. Mythos-class architecture built for sustained asynchronous execution, sub-agent orchestration, and advanced vision capabilities.
entries.usage:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()

message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-fable-5",
    max_tokens=128000,
    temperature=1.0,
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this codebase, identify any vulnerabilities, and rewrite the flawed modules with self-verifying test cases."}
    ]
)
print(message.content)
entries.benchmarks: Specific benchmarks aren't detailed in the snippets besides being "state-of-the-art on nearly all tested benchmarks" and having an OpenRouter Intelligence Index of 64.9 (#1) and Coding Index of 62.0.
entries.limitations: Premium pricing ($10/1M input, $50/1M output), 30-day mandatory data retention on Bedrock, heavy built-in safeguards that fall back to Opus 4.8 for sensitive topics, recently subject to US government export controls restricting foreign national access.
entries.description: Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's most intelligent, generally available "Mythos-class" model released in June 2026. import outlines

entries.name: PaliGemma 2
entries.summary: Google's open vision-language foundation model combining SigLIP-So400m vision encoder with Gemma 2 language models across 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter configurations for visual reasoning, captioning, and OCR.
entries.architecture: Dual-encoder cross-attention architecture uniting a SigLIP vision transformer with Gemma 2 autoregressive transformer decoder supporting high-resolution image tokens.

from transformers import PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration, AutoProcessor

model = PaliGemmaForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained("google/paligemma2-10b-pt-448", device_map="auto")

entries.description: Google's open vision-language foundation model combining SigLIP-So400m vision encoder with Gemma 2 language models across 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter configurations for visual reasoning, captioning, and OCR.

entries.name: Pinecone
entries.summary: A managed vector database purpose-built for AI applications, enabling fast similarity search at scale for RAG, semantic search, and recommendation systems.
entries.architecture: Managed ANNS (Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search) vector store with hybrid search support.
entries.usage:
from pinecone import Pinecone, ServerlessSpec
pc = Pinecone(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")
pc.create_index("my-index", dimension=1536, metric="cosine", spec=ServerlessSpec(cloud='aws', region='us-east-1'))
index = pc.Index("my-index")
index.upsert(vectors=[("vec1", [0.1, 0.2], {"text": "hello"})])
entries.benchmarks: Sub-10ms query latency at billion-vector scale
entries.limitations: Proprietary, can be expensive at scale vs. self-hosted alternatives.
entries.description: A managed vector database purpose-built for AI applications, enabling fast similarity search at scale for RAG, semantic search, and recommendation systems.

outputs = llm.generate([{"prompt": "Describe this diagram in detail.", "multi_modal_data": {"image": "diagram.png"}}])

entries.name: Qdrant
entries.summary: Open-source vector similarity search engine and vector database written in Rust, delivering ultra-fast, memory-efficient vector search with rich payload filtering and distributed clustering.
entries.architecture: Rust-native vector indexing engine with HNSW graph indexing, quantization (scalar & product), disk-backed payloads, and Raft distributed consensus.
entries.usage:
from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
from qdrant_client.models import Distance, VectorParams

client = QdrantClient("localhost", port=6333)
client.create_collection("ai_articles", vectors_config=VectorParams(size=1536, distance=Distance.COSINE))
entries.benchmarks: Sub-millisecond P99 vector search latency; stores billions of vectors with scalar quantization reducing RAM consumption by up to 4x.
entries.limitations: Requires planning shard layouts and replication factors before scaling to high-concurrency multi-node clusters.
entries.description: Open-source vector similarity search engine and vector database written in Rust, delivering ultra-fast, memory-efficient vector search with rich payload filtering and distributed clustering.
